Apple scab.symptoms: Olive-green to brown spots appear on leaves and fruit. Severe infection can cause leaf drop and fruit blemishes.
prevention: Remove fallen infected leaves and plant debris.
Maintain good air circulation by proper pruning.
treatment: Remove severely infected plant parts.
Apply an appropriate fungicide according to the product label and local agricultural recommendations.
Follow the recommended spray interval.
Apple scab.warning: Do not apply pesticides without checking the crop label, dosage and local agricultural guidance.

Black rot.symptoms: Dark circular lesions may develop on leaves and fruit. Fruit can develop dark rotting areas.
prevention: Remove mummified fruit and infected plant material.
treatment: Remove infected fruit and branches.
Dispose of infected plant material away from the orchard.
Use an appropriate registered fungicide when recommended locally.
Black rot.warning: Use only products registered for apple and follow the label.

Cedar apple rust.symptoms: Yellow-orange spots can appear on leaves, sometimes followed by darker structures on the underside.
prevention: Remove nearby alternate hosts where practical.
treatment: Remove severely affected leaves where practical.

Cedar apple rust.warning: Fungicide selection and timing should follow local agricultural recommendations.
